A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sanyassan''' was a [[Blurrg/Legends|blurrg]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] during the height of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Biography==
An [[Color/Legends|grey]]-skinned [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]], this individual sold [[Blurrg/Legends|blurrgs]], a race of [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] beast of burden from the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. At some point, he came to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], capital [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the Republic, and participated in the [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition|Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]]. During the fair, he bartered with a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] customer, trying to convince to buy his blurrgs rather than the [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] from another merchant.<ref name="SWFG" />
